note: Rates stated in an official source that was read in full on checked_on. Base and preferential rates are kept separate. Government contribution (6% or 12% of deposits) and interest-tax exemption are benefits, not rates, and are never added to these figures. No maturity amount or effective yield is calculated. The catalog file is not modified.

rates.evidence: Financial Services Commission press release on korea.kr (posted 2026-09-30), read in full on 2026-11-08: the product carries a 3-year fixed rate described as a 5% base plus preferential rate of up to 2-3%, with details on the Korea Federation of Banks consumer portal. The same text also quotes 'effective' yields of 13.2-14.4% (general) and 18.2-19.4% (preferential) that fold in the government contribution and the tax exemption; those are deliberately not carried here because they are not interest rates.
